cohort: Patients with a morbidly adherent placenta with or without previous caesarean section scar from 1999 to 2013
finding: The overall rate of morbidly adherent placenta increased from 0.17/1000 births in 1999-2003 to 0.79/1000 births in 2009-2013, with previous caesarean section and co-existing placenta praevia remaining the major risk factors.
mod_finding: Presence of a caesarean section scar remained the main risk factor for morbidly adherent placenta.
